title: Neochromosome and GlobalBio Launch Pre-Transformed Antibody Libraries in Switchable Yeast Platform
summary: GlobalBio’s validated, highly diverse human antibody libraries are now available pre-integrated into Neochromosome’s novel neoSwitch™ yeast strain, enabling rapid in-house antibody discovery via yeast display and streamlined lead characterization in secretion mode. LONG ISLAND CITY, N.Y.
